evals.prompt: Refresh Tarun's To Obsidian playlist, but only add videos I don't already have in Obsidian.
evals.expected_output: Reports the playlist count, creates no duplicate notes, and verifies that every playlist ID is classified as existing or failed.

evals.prompt: Process the latest videos in Tarun's playlist. One new transcript endpoint is rate-limited, so do not create a note for that video.
evals.expected_output: Processes other new videos, records the rate-limited ID explicitly, stops further transcript requests, and reports verification passed with a transcript failure when structural invariants hold.

evals.prompt: Add new playlist videos, but treat existing notes with watch URLs, youtu.be URLs, and Shorts URLs as already processed even when filenames differ.
evals.expected_output: Normalizes all three URL forms to IDs and skips matching notes without creating duplicates.

evals.prompt: Import the new videos. The transcript response contains repeated auto-caption spans and provider metadata.
evals.expected_output: Cleans repeated caption text and excludes timestamps, API metadata, music markers, sponsors, and filler from the note.

evals.prompt: Import a video whose title produces the same safe filename as an existing note with a different source ID.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the original title as H1 and appends the video ID only to the colliding filename.

evals.prompt: Refresh the playlist and verify the notes, icon mappings, Related Topics links, and YouTube Base without changing unrelated vault files.
evals.expected_output: Checks the exact frontmatter contract, required sections, valid links, ordinary-note emoji icons, no stale playlist file, and the Base folder filter.
